inputs.text: [excited] Bar… ee… on… iks. [curious] "Bary," in Greek, means heavy. [playful] And "onyx" means claw. The heavy claw!
[amazed] Onyx, like the shiny black stone? [confident] So that makes: the heavy claw.
[happily] Exactly right, same word. [confident] A HUGE claw, 12 inches long, on its thumb. It lived in Europe — England, Spain, and Portugal, [amazed] one hundred twenty-five million years ago.
[curious] What did it catch with a claw like that?
[playful] Fish. [amazed] Like a fishing bear, but a dinosaur.
